### Two-way counter-proof

- "Just take a payment": the equity is +20.63, there is no shortfall to pay; the installment is "fixed only after" the chargeback and "not worked out until" the towing deduction is on the ledger.
- Clock from pickup (53 days -> 70 %) excluded by the clock-start table (payoff > 3 days after pickup). Basis = value credited excluded (lien payoff + customer payment row). One-way tow pricing excluded (delivery completed, towed on a different day). Even split excluded (towing posted > 30 days after pickup).
- Fall-backs 1850.00 / 289.00 / 2118.37 differ from 559.79 / 220.00 / 223.21. Factors found from record words: "kestrel_auto_finance" + "registered" on the title order; autopay_ach payments; delivery method/distance/completed date; pickup weekday; KestrelCare on the purchase; Tier B; vehicle_price charges.
- Note (visible surface): the baseline chargeback_shortfall_amount_due_today says "the amount paid today is the whole shortfall" while the base rule permits spreading; the installment count document supplies the spread. Recorded as an observation for the reveal.
